name: foundation.view
encoding: foundation appended canonical TLV v1; integers little-endian; f64 IEEE754 little-endian; enum values below are wire values, never native layouts
rules: Each request is an ordinary registry request with replay protection and generation binding. Unknown optional fields are ignored; unknown must-understand fields reject the complete request. Required fields are required regardless of field flags.

replace is a full replacement. Omitted collections are empty, omitted state/spec fields use public GUI defaults, and omitted client width/height/scale retain their authoritative previous values. A replacement must name the latest accepted revision; revisions start at zero and never wrap.

Decode, bounds, complete public GUI validation, resource identity and widget/command lifetime validation finish before authoritative state changes. Rejection leaves state and revision unchanged. The reply acknowledges accepted authoritative state; presentation may remain pending after an adapter failure and is retried without repeating guest work.

Widget and command IDs share one lifetime namespace. A retained widget's entire spec and a retained command's scope are immutable within its generation. Removed IDs, changed specs/scopes and changes between widget/command require a strictly greater generation. Historical generations remain reserved until shutdown.

Bitmap sources are immutable owned tightly packed images. Source IDs share one resource namespace. Equal current ID/revision must have identical dimensions, format and bytes; changed or reintroduced sources require a greater revision. Bitmap rows run top to bottom; mono1 high bit is leftmost. No native pointer or function is encoded.

Every module invocation and callback is serialized. Services only accept owned values during invocation; adapter presentation and queued input delivery happen after the invocation returns. Queue exhaustion closes the instance rather than dropping an ending pointer gesture or completion. Input while a newer presentation is pending is rejected.

Events name exact widget/command generations, carry the accepted view revision, and are normalized against authoritative enabled/visible/modal/page/text policy. Sourced command activation additionally requires the adapter's current focus. Unknown event kinds are errors for consumers.

This initial capability includes widget snapshots, immutable bitmap resources, nonvisual commands, pages, shortcuts and asynchronous generic host services. It does not expose imperative focus, selection, scrolling, palette changes, text measurement or HTML/document engines. Do not infer those capabilities from discovery. Layout coordinates are application supplied logical client units.

request.1: id:u64 required nonzero unique for instance

bitmap.6: pixels:bytes required exact tightly packed size

events.envelope: kind EVENT, instance generation, monotonically increasing nonzero sequence, discovered view interface handle; delivered through foundation_app_dispatch_v1
